GAURAV ACHARYA SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST

Pune, India | Phone: +91- 9890126043| Email: Acharyagaurav_11@yahoo.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 8 years of professional experience across Public Sector, Education, Digital Wealth Management UI, Payments (SWIFT CBPR+ SR2025 Regulatory), Knowledge on cross-border payments and Telecom domains. Possesses 5 years of deep expertise in Senior Business Analysis and 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance Manual Testing. Extensively experienced in Agile delivery, stakeholder collaboration, requirement gathering, business process analysis, and cross-functional release coordination. Skilled at translating complex statutory frameworks and business policies into scalable digital solutions, designing target-state workflows, and driving successful end-to-end product implementations.

CORE SKILLS & DOMAIN EXPERTISE

Business Analysis: Requirements Elicitation, Gap Analysis, AS-IS & TO-BE Mapping, BRD/FRD Documentation, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria

Domain Expertise: Digital Wealth Management UI, Public Sector & Education Enterprise Applications, Payments (SWIFT CBPR+ SR2025 Regulatory), Knowledge on cross-border payments, Telecom CRM & Billing systems

Technical & Testing: Legacy Migration Strategy (Silverlight to WPF), Workflow Automation, Test Planning, Defect Management & Reporting Tools Used: Jira, Confluence, Swagger, Postman, SQL, ITrack, TDP, MS Excel

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Nov 2024 – April 2025

Senior Business Analyst – Education & Public Sector Infosys, Pune • Managed comprehensive requirements for key education and public sector enterprise applications, ensuring

alignment with organizational goals.

Translated complex public sector business policies into detailed functional specifications, granular user stories, and clear acceptance criteria for Agile development teams.

Led structured discovery workshops with diverse public sector stakeholders, end-users, and technical teams to refine project scope.

Defined the migration roadmap for legacy application modernization, driving the transition from Silverlight to WPF frameworks.

Orchestrated the design of target-state features by preparing comprehensive AS-IS and TO-BE business process workflows for core reporting and platform enhancements.

Partnered with cross-functional Scrum teams to coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies and define data-driven release criteria.

Key Achievement: Successfully managed critical migration initiatives that modernized core enterprise applications, minimizing disruption to public sector operations.

Key Achievement: Significantly enhanced platform usability and value by embedding strict accessibility compliance standards into the project requirements.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Senior Business Analyst - Payments (Host-to- Host (H2H) Corporate Payment Integration) Infosys, Pune

June 2022 – Oct 2024

Developed and implemented a Host-to-Host (H2H) payment integration solution to enable secure, automated, and seamless payment processing between corporate ERP systems and the bank's payment platform. The project supported domestic and international payment types, including RTGS, NEFT, ACH, SWIFT, and ISO 20022 payment messages. It streamlined payment initiation, file validation, transaction processing, acknowledgments, and reconciliation while reducing manual intervention, improving payment accuracy, and ensuring compliance with banking regulations and security standards.

Gathered and analyzed business requirements from business stakeholders, corporate clients, and

technical teams for Host-to-Host payment integration.

Conducted requirement elicitation sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews to understand

payment processing workflows and business needs.

Update, Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), user stories, process flow diagrams, and use case

documentation.

Analyzed As-Is and To-Be business processes and identified opportunities for process improvement. • Collaborated with solution architects, developers, QA teams, and banking operations throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Defined business rules and validation criteria for payment files, including duplicate detection,

mandatory field validation, account verification, and transaction limits.

Worked with payment file formats such as ISO 20022 CSV, and bank-specific formats for secure

payment processing.

Coordinated Host-to-Host integration using secure communication protocols such as SFTP, APIs,

connectivity.

Supported payment processing for domestic and international transactions, including RTGS, NEFT,

ACH, SWIFT, and other electronic payment methods.

Developed User stories, test cases, and acceptance criteria based on business requirements. • Supported System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing by validating payment processing.

Tracked defects using tools such as JIRA, coordinated issue resolution, and verified defect fixes. • Facilitated stakeholder communication by providing project status updates, conducting requirement



walkthroughs, and supporting change request analysis. Assisted in deployment planning, production validation, post-production support, and knowledge transfer activities.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Nov 2020 – 2022

Senior Business Analyst – Digital Wealth Management UI Deutsche Bank • Led the business analysis and requirement engineering for the end-to-end UI/UX redesign of a Digital Wealth

Management platform.

Streamlined complex workflows across core modules—including portfolio dashboards, goal tracking, transaction histories, and relationship manager engagement tools—to enhance compliance and user retention.

Facilitated cross-functional stakeholder workshops and user research interviews (Product, Compliance, UX, and Technology) to elicit, analyze, and document comprehensive functional and nonfunctional requirements.

Authored high-quality user stories, robust acceptance criteria (BDD/Gherkin format), and detailed process maps/wireframes for core modules.

Defined and integrated strict WCAG 2.1 compliance requirements into the design lifecycle, ensuring digital accessibility across diverse customer segments and mitigating regulatory risk.

Accelerated User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by designing comprehensive test scenarios and business validation cases, bridging the gap between business intent and technical execution.

Key Achievement: Optimized platform usability by resolving critical UX bottlenecks, reducing navigation complexity, and driving a reduction in user drop-off rates on the portfolio dashboard.

Key Achievement: Strengthened alignment between stakeholders, UX designers, and engineering teams, accelerating the feature delivery lifecycle.

Key Achievement: Contributed to the successful rollout of the Document Vault and Goal Tracking features, increasing daily active user engagement.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2018 – 2020

Manual Test Engineer – Telecom CRM & Billing Amdocs • Worked extensively on Telecom Billing systems and CRM applications supporting IPTV (DTV), HISA, and

both Wired & Wireless services.

Managed end-to-end financial reporting validation activities. • Performed detailed test planning, comprehensive test data preparation, and rigorous test execution. • Conducted defect tracking, reporting, and uploading test cases in TDP, while raising defects in ITrack & TDP. • Coordinated seamlessly with PMOs on daily status updates and progress reporting. EDUCATION

Bachelor in Foreign Trade (BFT) – Pune University (2009)

PERSONAL DETAILS

Nationality: Indian | Marital Status: Married
